proof:
intro hc
  classical
  let S : Submonoid ℤ := (IsUnit.submonoid K).comap (Int.castRingHom K)
  have hS (b : ℤ) : b ∈ S ↔ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b := by
    change IsUnit (b : K) ↔ _
    rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, CharP.intCast_eq_zero_iff K p]
  have hb0 (b : ℤ) (hb : b ∈ S) : (b : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (fun hz : b = 0 => (hS b).mp hb (hz ▸ dvd_zero _))
  letI : IsLocalization S (R p) := by
    refine (isLocalization_iff S (R p)).mpr ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro b
      let t : R p := ⟨(b.val : ℚ)⁻¹, Subring.subset_closure ⟨b.val, (hS b.val).mp b.property, rfl⟩⟩
      apply isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mpr
      refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (b.val : ℚ) * (b.val : ℚ)⁻¹ = 1
      exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (hb0 b.val b.property)
    · intro r
      obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hr⟩ := (h_T008.1 (r : ℚ)).mp r.property
      refine ⟨(a, ⟨b, (hS b).mpr hb⟩), ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (r : ℚ) * (b : ℚ) = (a : ℚ)
      rw [hr, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hb0 b ((hS b).mpr hb))]
    · intro a b hab
      refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      have he : a = b := by
        have heq := congrArg (fun r : R p => (r : ℚ)) hab
        exact_mod_cast heq
      simp [he]
  have hu : ∀ b : S, IsUnit (Int.castRingHom K b) := fun b => b.property
  let κ : R p →+* K := IsLocalization.lift hu
  have hκ : ∀ (a b : ℤ) (r : R p), (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ) →
      ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b → κ r = (a : K) * (b : K)⁻¹ := by
    intro a b r hr hb
    have hbr : r * (b : R p) = (a : R p) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (r : ℚ) * (b : ℚ) = (a : ℚ)
      rw [hr, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hb0 b ((hS b).mpr hb))]
    have hk : κ r * (b : K) = (a : K) := by
      simpa using congrArg κ hbr
    rw [← div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact (eq_div_iff (by simpa [CharP.intCast_eq_zero_iff K p] using hb)).mpr hk
  letI := κ.toAlgebra
  letI := ZMod.algebra K p
  let C : RK κ M ≃ₗ[K] VK K M :=
    TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange ℤ (R p) K K M
  have hC : canonicalR κ M C := by
    intro c r m
    rfl
  have hCi : ∀ (f : Module.End ℤ M) (w : RK κ M),
      C (throughR κ f w) = f.baseChange K (C w) := by
    intro f w
    induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp [throughR]
    | add a b ha hb => simp_all [throughR]
    | tmul c u =>
      induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp [throughR]
      | add a b ha hb => simp_all [throughR, TensorProduct.tmul_add]
      | tmul r m => rfl
  letI : TensorProduct.CompatibleSMul ℤ (R p) K (MR p M) :=
    IsLocalization.tensorProduct_compatibleSMul S (R p) K (MR p M)
  let E : RK κ M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[ℤ] MR p M :=
    TensorProduct.equivOfCompatibleSMul ℤ (R p) K K (MR p M)
  let F : FK p K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[ℤ] MR p M :=
    TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange ℤ (ZMod p) K K (MR p M)
  let D : FK p K M ≃ₗ[K] VK K M := F.trans (E.symm.trans C)
  have hD : canonicalF κ M D := by
    intro c a r m
    change C ((E.symm) (((a : ZMod p) • c) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (r ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m))) = _
    change (κ r * ((algebraMap (ZMod p) K a) * c)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m = _
    have hcast : algebraMap (ZMod p) K a = (ZMod.cast a : K) := rfl
    rw [hcast]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hDi : ∀ (f : Module.End ℤ M) (w : FK p K M),
      D (throughF p K f w) = f.baseChange K (D w) := by
    intro f w
    induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp [throughF]
    | add a b ha hb => simp_all [throughF]
    | tmul c u =>
      induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp [throughF]
      | add a b ha hb => simp_all [throughF, TensorProduct.tmul_add]
      | tmul a u =>
        induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
        | zero => simp [throughF]
        | add u v hu hv => simp_all [throughF, TensorProduct.tmul_add]
        | tmul r m => rfl
  exact ⟨κ, hκ, C, hC, hCi, D, hD, hDi⟩
